scripts.script:
--!strict
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local TeleportService = game:GetService("TeleportService")
local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")

-- CONFIGURATION
local HEAD_ADMINS: { [number]: boolean } = {
	[12345678] = true, -- Replace with your Roblox User ID
}

local TARGET_PLACE_ID: number = 0 -- Replace with your Realm/Map Place ID

-- HELPER FUNCTIONS
local function isAdmin(player: Player): boolean
	return HEAD_ADMINS[player.UserId] == true
end

local function getPlayerByName(name: string): Player?
	for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		if player.Name:lower():sub(1, #name) == name:lower() then
			return player
		end
	end
	return nil
end

-- COMMAND HANDLER
local function executeCommand(admin: Player, message: string)
	local args = string.split(message, " ")
	local command = args[1]:lower()

	-- 1. Fly a Realm (Teleport player to another map place)
	if command == ";flyrealm" then
		local targetName = args[2]
		if not targetName then return end
		
		local targetPlayer = getPlayerByName(targetName)
		if targetPlayer then
			pcall(function()
				TeleportService:Teleport(TARGET_PLACE_ID, targetPlayer)
			end)
		end

	-- 2. Same Avatar (Copy admin's appearance to everyone currently in the game)
	elseif command == ";sameavatar" then
		local adminCharacter = admin.Character
		if not adminCharacter then return end
		
		local adminHumanoid = adminCharacter:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if not adminHumanoid then return end
		
		local description = adminHumanoid:GetAppliedDescription()
		if not description then return end

		for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
			if player ~= admin then
				local char = player.Character
				local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
				if hum then
					pcall(function()
						hum:ApplyDescription(description)
					end)
				end
			end
		end

	-- 3. Fog (Change environmental lighting fog settings)
	elseif command == ";fog" then
		local colorStr = args[2] or "0,0,0"
		local rgb = string.split(colorStr, ",")
		local r = tonumber(rgb[1]) or 0
		local g = tonumber(rgb[2]) or 0
		local b = tonumber(rgb[3]) or 0
		
		Lighting.FogColor = Color3.fromRGB(r, g, b)
		Lighting.FogStart = 0
		Lighting.FogEnd = 100

	-- 4. Shutdown (Safely kick all players from the server)
	elseif command == ";shutdown" then
		for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
			player:Kick("Server is shutting down by admin order.")
		end
	end
end

-- LISTENERS
Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
	player.Chatted:Connect(function(message)
		if isAdmin(player) then
			executeCommand(player, message)
		end
	end)
end)

scripts.title: Malicious Script Detector
scripts.script:
local StarterGui = game:GetService("StarterGui")

-- Define the list of custom environment functions you want to test
local functionsToTest = {
    "getgenv",
    "getrenv",
    "getreg",
    "getfenv",
    "setclipboard",
    "decompile",
    "hookfunction",
    "request",
    "gethui"
}

local missingOrFailing = {}

-- Function to safely test if a function exists and executes without crashing
local function testFunction(name)
    -- Check if global exists and is a function
    local fn = getfenv()[name]
    if not fn and type(getgenv) == "function" then
        local success, genv = pcall(getgenv)
        if success and type(genv) == "table" then
            fn = genv[name]
        end
    end

    if type(fn) ~= "function" then
        return false, "Not defined"
    end

    return true, "Working"
end

-- Run tests
for _, fnName in ipairs(functionsToTest) do
    local works, status = testFunction(fnName)
    if not works then
        table.insert(missingOrFailing, fnName)
    end
end

-- Notify user via Roblox's native notification system
if #missingOrFailing > 0 then
    local failedList = table.concat(missingOrFailing, ", ")
    
    StarterGui:SetCore("SendNotification", {
        Title = ":(",
        Text = "not working: " .. failedList,
        Duration = 7
    })
else
    StarterGui:SetCore("SendNotification", {
        Title = "check is good",
        Text = "all of the functions work so starting script",
        Duration = 5
    })
end

scripts.features: Basically scans for all scripts and modulescripts and localscripts, for scripts, it will tell you there is some Script exposed to the client (you cant basically see in it unless it told you it had a bytecode), and for modulescripts, it will check if it has vulnerable names, executor apis, and dynamic execution calls, it will check if there is obfuscation, and webhooks/urls, debug library abuses are checked, and it will check if it creates new scripts or load any external source code, and for localscript, it will check if it uses PromptProductPurchaseFinished or PromptGamepassPurchaseFinished, and if it contains those, you can just use 7yd7 gamepass, and will check if there is weak anti-cheats inside localscripts,  and if they do, you can just disable or delete it, and it will check if they send remotes in localscripts (maybe some that tells to ban people), and if they contain it, you can use it to abuse that power, or disable it to avoid getting bans.
